summary.what_it_is: RustText is a portable Windows text editor with Sublime Text-style multi-cursor editing, regex find and replace, split views, and a live viewer for large log files. It also includes workspaces, draft archives, local file history, and built-in tools like a proxy checker and list comparison.
summary.why_trending: The project is only 6 days old and has gained 470 stars this week, likely due to its recent release as a feature-rich portable editor for large logs and JSON files.
summary.who_its_for: Windows users who want a portable, Sublime-like editor with large log file support and built-in utilities.
